title: The Five Awakeners
description: Of those who are dead — souls separated from the source of life by what they have claimed — the resurrection is at hand. The Lord raises the rational not by a single stroke but in five distinct operations, five degrees of one upward drawing: the first lifting from where the soul lies; the second drawing further upward; the third inmost Father going forth to gather what was scattered; the fourth ordering the inner mind toward the Good itself; the fifth completing the work in conjunction. These bear many names — Loosing, Stillness, Fast, Day, Rest, Peace — for the soul recognizes one operation under whatever aspect it most needs.
